chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Abi Zahir, from al-Khashshab, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام), who said:
The one who had knowledge from the Book said: “I shall bring it to you before your glance returns to you.”
He said: Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام) spread his fingers apart and placed them on his chest, then said: “And with us, by Allah, is the knowledge of the Book, all of it.”

key_terms.أَصَابِعِهِ: his fingers, used in the Imam's gesture
key_terms.الْكِتَابِ: the Book; the revealed scripture referred to in the verse and hadith
key_terms.طَرْفُكَ: your glance or blink of the eye
key_terms.عِلْمُ الْكِتَابِ: the knowledge of the Book in its complete sense

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says the Imams possess the knowledge of the Book, all of it?
ai.summary: This hadith cites the Qur'anic statement about one who possessed knowledge from the Book and could bring the throne in an instant. Imam Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام) then declares that the Ahl al-Bayt possess, by Allah, the knowledge of the Book in its entirety, indicating their divinely granted authority and comprehensive knowledge.
